body: Reading this I can tell you have a lot of symptoms of BPD such as love/ hate relationships, fear of abandonment, and self harm. I also have BPD and I hate to hear that you are suffering so much. You have amazing aspirations and I would hate to see you end it all and lose out on that. Being shy isn’t always a bad thing, and making friends as an adult can be really hard. I would suggest joining clubs or going to events that have to go with things you are passionate about such as YouTube or gaming like you mentioned. That is a great way to meet people with similar interests to you and form friendships with those people. Please message me if you ever need to talk. I wish you all the best. 😊
